$Comment: What the Hallowed leave a player each time their favor climbs another step past Exalted: the
table. Every roll is read on its own: the first always pays and plays the moment
Hallows_Eve_Hallowed_Cache (a toast and a sound), so the cache never lands unannounced; the
second is a chance on top. Chance is a percent from 0 to 100. Sweets pay through the Currency
reward kind, since a counter wallet has no item to hand over.
Text names the reward on the Hallowed's Reputation page and in the notice that pays it (Hallowed
Cache instead of Loot Bundle) and gives its hover a line; the hover then lists what this table pays.
Name: Hallows_Eve_Hallowed_Cache
